description: At the shop's south doorway, the floor tile pattern forms a classic Hidden Mickey underfoot, three circles set into the tilework right where you step through the door.

whereToLook.scene: The south doorway of Cristal d'Orleans, the floor
whereToLook.exactSpot: The floor tiles in the doorway. Look down for the three-circle shape in the pattern.

bestTip: Step to the side of the door so you are not standing on it while you look.
